description: NL->SQL questions over the `nyc-taxi` dataset (public/data/datasets.json): trips (9,417,430 NYC yellow taxi trips, January-March 2024, 19 columns: taxi_type, vendor_id, pickup_time/dropoff_time TIMESTAMP local, pickup_zone_id/dropoff_zone_id, passenger_count, trip_distance miles, rate_code, payment_type, eight money columns in USD, total_amount) and zones(zone_id, borough, zone, service_zone, lat, lon). Many questions need a JOIN on zone ids. The prompt's "now" is max(pickup_time) = 2024-03-31 23:59:59; $SINCE expands on pickup_time. Same scoring rules as evals/sql-corpus.json.

cases.question: number of trips per day
reference: SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', pickup_time) AS day, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: trips by hour of day
cases.reference: SELECT hour(pickup_time) AS hour, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average fare by pickup borough
reference: SELECT z.borough, avg(t.fare_amount) AS fare FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT z.borough, avg(t.total_amount) AS fare FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: top 10 pickup zones
reference: SELECT z.zone, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT pickup_zone_id, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT z.zone, z.borough, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: top 5 routes between zones
reference: SELECT p.zone AS pickup_zone, d.zone AS dropoff_zone, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones p ON t.pickup_zone_id = p.zone_id JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_zone_id = d.zone_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT pickup_zone_id, dropoff_zone_id, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: average tip percentage for credit card payments
reference: SELECT avg(100.0 * tip_amount / fare_amount) AS tip_pct FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 'credit card' AND fare_amount > 0
SELECT 100.0 * sum(tip_amount) / sum(fare_amount) AS tip_pct FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 'credit card'
SELECT avg(100.0 * tip_amount / total_amount) AS tip_pct FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 'credit card' AND total_amount > 0
SELECT 100.0 * sum(tip_amount) / sum(total_amount) AS tip_pct FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 'credit card'
cases.note: Per-trip mean or ratio of sums; relative to fare or total.

cases.question: how do people pay
reference: SELECT payment_type, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT payment_type, 100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER () AS share FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT payment_type, count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER () AS share FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: median trip duration in minutes
reference: SELECT median(date_diff('second', pickup_time, dropoff_time) / 60.0) AS minutes FROM trips
SELECT median(date_diff('minute', pickup_time, dropoff_time)) AS minutes FROM trips
SELECT median(epoch(dropoff_time - pickup_time) / 60) AS minutes FROM trips
SELECT quantile_cont(date_diff('second', pickup_time, dropoff_time) / 60.0, 0.5) AS minutes FROM trips

cases.question: 90th percentile trip duration by pickup borough
reference: SELECT z.borough, quantile_cont(date_diff('second', t.pickup_time, t.dropoff_time) / 60.0, 0.9) AS minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT z.borough, quantile_disc(date_diff('second', t.pickup_time, t.dropoff_time) / 60.0, 0.9) AS minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT z.borough, quantile_cont(date_diff('minute', t.pickup_time, t.dropoff_time), 0.9) AS minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: pickups at JFK per day
reference: SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, count(*) AS trips FROM trips WHERE pickup_zone_id = 132 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', pickup_time) AS day, count(*) AS trips FROM trips WHERE pickup_zone_id = 132 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: JFK Airport is zone 132; only zones.zone says so.

cases.question: average trip distance by hour of day
cases.reference: SELECT hour(pickup_time) AS hour, avg(trip_distance) AS trip_distance FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: total airport fees collected
cases.reference: SELECT sum(airport_fee) AS airport_fee FROM trips

cases.question: trips per week by payment type
cases.reference: SELECT date_trunc('week', pickup_time) AS week, payment_type, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: map of pickups by zone
reference:
-- view: map
SELECT z.zone, z.lat, z.lon, count(*) AS pickups FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

-- view: map
SELECT z.zone, z.lat, z.lon, count(*) AS pickups FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.lat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

-- view: map
SELECT z.lat, z.lon, count(*) AS pickups FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.lat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

-- view: map
SELECT z.zone_id, z.zone, z.lat, z.lon, count(*) AS pickups FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average number of passengers per trip
reference: SELECT avg(passenger_count) AS passengers FROM trips
SELECT avg(passenger_count) AS passengers FROM trips WHERE passenger_count > 0

cases.question: 7-day rolling average of daily trips
reference: WITH d AS (SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1) SELECT day, avg(trips) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg FROM d ORDER BY day

WITH d AS (SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, count(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1) SELECT day, trips, avg(trips) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg FROM d ORDER BY day

cases.question: highest-revenue pickup zone in each borough
reference: WITH r AS (SELECT z.borough, z.zone, sum(t.total_amount) AS revenue, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY z.borough ORDER BY sum(t.total_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT borough, zone, revenue FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY borough

WITH r AS (SELECT z.borough, z.zone, sum(t.total_amount) AS revenue, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY z.borough ORDER BY sum(t.total_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT borough, zone FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY borough

cases.question: share of trips that start in Manhattan
reference: SELECT avg((z.borough = 'Manhattan')::INTEGER) AS share FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id
SELECT 100.0 * avg((z.borough = 'Manhattan')::INTEGER) AS share FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id

cases.question: how many trips were longer than 20 miles
cases.reference: SELECT count(*) AS trips FROM trips WHERE trip_distance > 20

cases.question: average taxi speed in mph by hour of day
reference: SELECT hour(pickup_time) AS hour, sum(trip_distance) / (sum(date_diff('second', pickup_time, dropoff_time)) / 3600.0) AS mph FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT hour(pickup_time) AS hour, avg(trip_distance / (date_diff('second', pickup_time, dropoff_time) / 3600.0)) AS mph FROM trips WHERE dropoff_time > pickup_time GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average tip by day of week
reference: SELECT dayname(pickup_time) AS weekday, avg(tip_amount) AS tip FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT isodow(pickup_time) AS weekday, avg(tip_amount) AS tip FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT dayofweek(pickup_time) AS weekday, avg(tip_amount) AS tip FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT isodow(pickup_time) AS dow, dayname(pickup_time) AS weekday, avg(tip_amount) AS tip FROM trips GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
SELECT dayofweek(pickup_time) AS dow, dayname(pickup_time) AS weekday, avg(tip_amount) AS tip FROM trips GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

cases.question: congestion surcharge collected per day
reference: SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, sum(congestion_surcharge) AS congestion_surcharge FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', pickup_time) AS day, sum(congestion_surcharge) AS congestion_surcharge FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: trips per hour over the last 7 days
reference: SELECT date_trunc('hour', pickup_time) AS hour, count(*) AS trips FROM trips WHERE $SINCE(7 days) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: fares
reference: SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, avg(fare_amount) AS fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', pickup_time) AS day, avg(fare_amount) AS fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, sum(fare_amount) AS fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', pickup_time) AS day, sum(fare_amount) AS fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT hour(pickup_time) AS hour, avg(fare_amount) AS fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.reference: SELECT count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.borough = 'Staten Island'

SELECT avg(trip_distance) AS trip_distance, avg(fare_amount) AS fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY pickup_zone_id ORDER BY 1

-- view: scatter

cases.question: busiest dropoff zone in Brooklyn
reference: SELECT z.zone, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT z.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_zone_id = z.zone_id WHERE z.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: total revenue per month
reference: SELECT date_trunc('month', pickup_time) AS month, sum(total_amount) AS revenue FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT month(pickup_time) AS month, sum(total_amount) AS revenue FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: daily trips per pickup borough
reference: SELECT t.pickup_time::DATE AS day, z.borough, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT date_trunc('day', t.pickup_time) AS day, z.borough, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_zone_id = z.zone_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: average trip time from JFK to Manhattan
reference: SELECT avg(date_diff('second', t.pickup_time, t.dropoff_time) / 60.0) AS minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_zone_id = d.zone_id WHERE t.pickup_zone_id = 132 AND d.borough = 'Manhattan'
SELECT avg(date_diff('minute', t.pickup_time, t.dropoff_time)) AS minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_zone_id = d.zone_id WHERE t.pickup_zone_id = 132 AND d.borough = 'Manhattan'
SELECT avg(epoch(t.dropoff_time - t.pickup_time) / 60) AS minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_zone_id = d.zone_id WHERE t.pickup_zone_id = 132 AND d.borough = 'Manhattan'

cases.question: share of JFK flat-rate trips per day
reference: SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, avg((rate_code = 'JFK')::INTEGER) AS share FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, 100.0 * avg((rate_code = 'JFK')::INTEGER) AS share FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_code = 'JFK') / count(*) AS share FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT pickup_time::DATE AS day, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_code = 'JFK') / count(*) AS share FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
cases.note: rate_code is NULL for some trips; avg over a NULL comparison skips them, count(*) does not.
